value.template_vars:
={{ {
"TOPIC": $('main_trigger').first().json.TOPIC,
"DESCRIPTION": $('main_trigger').first().json.DESCRIPTION,
"URL": $('main_trigger').first().json.URL || "",
"MAX_WORDS": $('main_trigger').first().json.MAX_WORDS,
"ASSET_TYPES": $('main_trigger').first().json.ASSET_TYPES || "",
"EXTRA_PROMPT": $('main_trigger').first().json.EXTRA_PROMPT || "",
"CONTENT": $('main_trigger').first().json.CONTENT || "",
"FEEDBACK": ($('main_trigger').first().json.FEEDBACK || "") + ($json.explanation ? "\nInternal review rejected the previous draft with: " + $json.explanation : ""),
"PREVIOUS_DRAFT": $('parse_article').isExecuted ? $('parse_article').last().json.TEXT : ($('main_trigger').first().json.PREVIOUS_DRAFT || ""),
"STRUCTURES": $('download_article_structures').first().json.output,
} }}

parameters.name: read_page
parameters.description: Fetch one URL and return its readable text. Use it on a link the other tools returned, or on a documentation URL.

parameters.name: research_sources
parameters.description: Search Hacker News and the author's RSS feeds for a subject. Returns a digest of titles, URLs, points and comment counts. Use it first; read a result with read_page before relying on it.
